newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Oct steel output hits 1.16 million tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Oct steel output hits 1.16 million tonnes.

text.p: Mexican steel output in reached a monthly record 1.16 million tonnes in October, breaking the previous best set in January this year of 1.131 million tonnes, the National Steel Chamber said Tuesday.

That record keeps Mexico on track to produce a record annual output of 13 million tonnes during 1996. If this goal is achieved, it would be 7 percent greater than the 12.1 million tonnes produced in 1995, the chamber added.
October's production is up 8.4 percent from the 1.07 million tonne output achieved in October 1995, the chamber said in a monthly update.
In the first 10 months of the year, production has reached 10.928 million tonnes, up 9.3 percent from the 9.998 million tonne output recorded in the same period in 1995.

The chamber said national consumption is seen up 35.6 percent in 1996 at 8.2 million tonnes from 6 million tonnes in 1995, although still below 9 million tonnes in 1994. Mexico's recession brought a severe drop in national steel demand.

Output was 1.131 million tonnes in January, 1.021 million tonnes in February, 1.073 million tonnes in March, 1.057 million tonnes in April, 1.082 million tonnes in May and 1.077 million tonnes in June.
In July, output reached 1.098 million tonnes, 1.125 million tonnes in August, 1.106 million tonnes in September and 1.16 million tonnes in October, the chamber said.
